tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Check that the desktop and browser are up.

tools.name: get-state
tools.description: Look at your computer: who is in control, the focused window, the browser tab and an accessibility snapshot of the page with element refs ([ref=e12]) to use with click/type-text/scroll. Start every task with this. Set screenshot=true when you need pixels (dialogs, canvas, images, layout).

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot of the whole screen (JPEG, downscaled). Coordinates you then pass to click/scroll/drag are pixels of THIS image; scaling to the real screen is automatic. Prefer get-state (text) when the target is in the web page.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element by ref (from the latest snapshot) or at x,y (pixels of the latest screenshot). Returns the fresh state. Ref clicks are delivered to the element; coordinate clicks are synthetic input — check the returned state.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over coordinates for anything in the web page.

x.description: X in pixels of the LATEST SCREENSHOT (scaled to screen automatically). Use when there is no ref.

y.description: Y in pixels of the latest screenshot.

observe.description: What to return after acting. snapshot (default): summary + accessibility snapshot with fresh refs. summary: control/window/url only. screenshot: summary + screenshot. none: nothing.

tools.name: type-text
tools.description: Type text. With ref: fills that field (replacing its content unless clear=false) and reads it back (verified). Without ref: types into whatever has keyboard focus (unverified). Never type passwords or other secrets: ask the user to take over and type them.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over coordinates for anything in the web page.

clear.description: With ref: replace existing content (default true).

observe.description: What to return after acting. snapshot (default): summary + accessibility snapshot with fresh refs. summary: control/window/url only. screenshot: summary + screenshot. none: nothing.

tools.name: press-key
tools.description: Press keys on the focused window: one key or chord, or several separated by spaces. Examples: "Enter", "Escape", "Tab", "ctrl+l", "ctrl+shift+t", "ctrl+a Delete", "PageDown".

observe.description: What to return after acting. snapshot (default): summary + accessibility snapshot with fresh refs. summary: control/window/url only. screenshot: summary + screenshot. none: nothing.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page or the element under a ref / point. amount is in wheel notches (~100 px each, default 5).

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over coordinates for anything in the web page.

x.description: X in pixels of the LATEST SCREENSHOT (scaled to screen automatically). Use when there is no ref.

y.description: Y in pixels of the latest screenshot.

observe.description: What to return after acting. snapshot (default): summary + accessibility snapshot with fresh refs. summary: control/window/url only. screenshot: summary + screenshot. none: nothing.

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Drag with the left button from one point to another (pixels of the latest screenshot).

observe.description: What to return after acting. snapshot (default): summary + accessibility snapshot with fresh refs. summary: control/window/url only. screenshot: summary + screenshot. none: nothing.

tools.name: open-url
tools.description: Open a URL in the desktop browser (starts it if closed), in the current tab or a new one. Waits for the page to load and returns its snapshot.

newTab.description: Open in a new tab (default false).

observe.description: What to return after acting. snapshot (default): summary + accessibility snapshot with fresh refs. summary: control/window/url only. screenshot: summary + screenshot. none: nothing.

tools.name: tabs
tools.description: List, switch to, close or open browser tabs. Tab indexes come from action=list.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait for some text to appear in the page (preferred) or for a fixed time, then return the state.

text.description: Wait until this text is visible in the page.

observe.description: What to return after acting. snapshot (default): summary + accessibility snapshot with fresh refs. summary: control/window/url only. screenshot: summary + screenshot. none: nothing.

tools.name: run-command
tools.description: Run a shell command on your computer as its user (bash, in the home directory) and get stdout/stderr. For files (e.g. ~/Downloads), quick checks and scripts. Not root: no system package installs.

tools.name: control-status
tools.description: Who is driving this computer right now: you (agent) or a person who took over from the live view. While a person is in control your input tools fail with human_has_control.
